ITEM.PTXT: The skid control computer converts the wheel speed pulse signals of 48 pulses per 1 tire revolution output from the speed sensors installed on each wheel into a vehicle speed signal and sends it to the combination meter via CAN communication. At the same time, to output the vehicle speed signal to computers, etc. that do not support CAN communication, the skid control computer converts the wheel speed pulse signals into a vehicle speed rectangular wave pulse signal equivalent to 4 pulses per 1 revolution of the transmission rotating shaft and outputs it to the combination meter.
